name: Wingman Window Left
description: Opens Wingman's game window (the nested display's 'Xwayland on :N' window, or the game's own window when it runs on the session display) at the top-left of its monitor, logs when that window stops being shown, and holds a one-pixel copy of it so the game is drawn at full rate while hidden. ADR 155, ADR 099 V3.
